findings.title: Complete bounded-process classification is asserted rather than derived from a full system snapshot
evidence: bounded_process_snapshot supplies system_process_count plus only the rows already classified as bounded candidates.
The policy verifies that bounded_candidate_count equals the supplied bounded-row count, but it receives no complete system snapshot rows from which to derive that count.
snapshot_status COMPLETE, omission_status NONE, access_status ALL_ROWS_OPENED, and the production collector provenance booleans are caller-supplied fields.
A hidden OneDrive or other bounded-name process can be omitted while the remaining two rows and all supplied counts remain internally consistent.
findings.counterevidence: The policy rejects any supplied incomplete, inaccessible, reused, omitted, exited, unclassified, or unrelated bounded row; its result is explicitly machine-only, non-authorizing, and blocked from canonical execution.
findings.adjudication: The nonclaim prevents current authority escalation but does not close V3-NEXT-004. The pure policy needs a full normalized system snapshot row set, exact enumeration API/terminal status/count/digest, and separate opened evidence for every policy-derived bounded candidate.
findings.required_repair: In a new policy generation, include every enumerated PID/name/parent row, require terminal ERROR_NO_MORE_FILES and exact snapshot digest/count, derive the bounded candidate set inside policy, then require exact PID/start/executable evidence for each derived candidate. Preserve hidden/renamed/kernel writer dissent.

findings.title: Runtime artifact hashes remain declarative until a real reviewed component lock and sealed launcher verify loaded bytes
evidence: The exact typed graph rejects unknown nodes, edges, and known design/allowlist hash drift.

Hashes for policy_v3_1, policy tests, production_collector, wrapper, kernel, primitive, checker, and launcher are supplied by the component-lock document rather than compared to loaded runtime bytes by this pure function.
The green unit fixture intentionally uses synthetic hashes for those future artifacts.
findings.counterevidence: This separation is compatible with an acyclic external reviewed-release and detached-digest architecture; a pure policy should not claim to inspect its own loaded file.
findings.adjudication: Not a reason to reject the pure deterministic core by itself, but it prevents component-lock, reviewed-release, or launcher qualification until a separate sealed loader verifies every loaded artifact byte against an independently reviewed exact graph.
findings.required_repair: A later production integration must construct a real exact graph from frozen artifacts, obtain independent component review, and have a sealed loader verify loaded bytes before creating any machine-pass input.

findings.title: The safer native helper remains permanently production-ineligible
evidence: The helper explicitly reports diagnostic/non-exhaustive process evidence.
It has no production collector, transaction kernel, launcher, owner capability, or cleanup authority.
The low-level contention method is private and the public probe accepts only an issued lease resource token, but the helper still requests write/delete access for disposable-fixture contention tests.
findings.counterevidence: The helper no longer accepts an arbitrary caller path for contention, does not write or delete bytes, retains exact handles, and honestly discloses auxiliary system opens and unmeasured metadata/hydration effects.
findings.adjudication: Retain as draft test evidence only. Never import it as the production collector or production provenance source.
findings.required_repair: None inside this test-only generation beyond independent verification; production work must use a separately named implementation.
